description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ConfigNotFoundException' within the 'OrangeHRM\ORM\Exception' namespace, used to represent configuration not found errors in the ORM layer of the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: ConfigNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception class used to indicate that a configuration was not found, extending the base PHP Exception class.

methods.name: notInstalled
methods.description: A static method that returns an instance of ConfigNotFoundException with a specific message indicating the application is not installed.
